pages.text: $(bold)Daylight Detector$() outputs by sky light — right-click to invert it into a night sensor. $(bold)Lightning Rod$() emits when struck. $(bold)Sculk Sensor$() (and the $(bold)Calibrated$() variant) hears vibrations and outputs their type.
pages.title: Sky & Sound

pages.text: $(bold)Season Sensor.$() $(italic)Serene Seasons$() adds a daylight-detector cousin that reads the $(bold)season$() instead of the sun — strongest in its tuned season, tapering toward the others. Wire seasonal farms, doors, or lighting to the calendar itself.
pages.title: Season Sensor

pages.text: $(bold)A note on weather.$() Under Novus' $(italic)Simple Clouds$() weather, the global rain flag a daylight detector watches is frozen — so it $(italic)won't$() catch a Simple Clouds storm, and Quark's Weather Detector is disabled for the same reason.$(br2)The one block that reads Simple Clouds storms is the $(italic)Supplementaries$() $(bold)Wind Vane$() (via Simple Clouds Compat) — see the $(italic)Traveler's Companion$().
pages.title: Weather → the Wind Vane
